name: qa-orchestrator
description: Orchestrate QA agent workflows — spawn test agents in parallel, collect results, triage bugs, trigger the bug fixer, and generate QA reports. The main entry point for running a QA session. Trigger on "run QA", "start QA session", "test the PR", "orchestrate QA agents", or when the user wants to run multiple QA agents together. Also triggered by /qa-orchestrator.
